prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Interactive flow additions were the most effective changes, winning up to +14.8% and often exceeding predictions, though later tests showed no clear effect when overpredicted (+14.8% predicted vs +3.3% measured).
Reordering onboarding flow steps produced major wins (up to +12.0%), but carries severe downside risks (down to -8.9%) and frequently showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates yielded wins for account persistence notices (+3.5%) and launch buttons (+6.7%), though most other copy changes showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting screen features produced one significant win (+3.9%), but mostly showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns failed to produce any wins, performed worse than predicted, and frequently caused severe performance drops (down to -19.3%).
Hints, notifications, layout changes, and standalone preview screens yielded no wins, with hints sometimes hurting performance (-3.1%) and the rest showing no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +9.0% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -12.5% over 3 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -3.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +2.6% over 4 test(s)
- finish, layout: -4.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: +7.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.6% over 2 test(s)
- home, hint: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +6.5% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.5% over 5 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +2.1% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.4% over 8 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 29.7%

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Routine Sandbox Flow: Adds an interactive routine sandbox to the final onboarding step where users can test feeding, sleeping, and moving the pet before launching to desktop. (why: Finish step has a median duration of 395s and 5815s mean, while support receives emails asking how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
1: [home, new_flow] Interactive Pet Emotion Sound Board Flow: Integrates an interactive pet emotion sound board into the waiting screen, allowing users to test pet sound cues and reactions while setup finishes. (why: Home waiting screen takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating high drop-off during background generation.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Pet Personality Quiz Screen: Inserts a short, interactive personality quiz screen right before adoption certificate to let users pick active, calm, or curious pet dispositions. (why: Adoption has a 71.2% conversion rate and 89s median completion time; adding interactive selection builds personal attachment and clarity.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Taskbar Control Guidance Copy: Adds explicit instructions and hint copy to the home intro screen detailing how to summon, minimize, and access pet controls via system tray. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding setup.)
4: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Processing Safety and Retry Indicator: Provides real-time feedback and photo processing status on the photo upload screen to prevent silent failures during custom pet generation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or rendering incorrectly during the photo step.)
5: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Workspace Decorator Flow: Adds an interactive desktop preview decorator flow on the waiting screen where users place virtual pet beds and toys while files load. (why: Home waiting duration mean of 2336s benefits from immersive interactive mini-activities proven to raise retention.)

scores.note: Interactive flows are highly effective on finish step, supported by funnel duration and direct support feedback.
Interactive flow additions during home setup step consistently drive positive engagement during long waits.
Adding standalone screens historically underperforms and risks reducing conversion despite adoption drop-off.
Targeted copy changes resolving explicit support emails yield low-cost, consistent positive results.
Status feedback addresses direct support complaints on high-loss adoption step with moderate effort.
Interactive mini-apps on long home waiting screen align with top-performing new_flow pattern.
